name: io.github.JonathanRReed/apple-numbers-mcp
title: Apple Numbers
description: Read, fill and export Apple Numbers spreadsheets on macOS.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_NUMBERS_MCP_SAFETY_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Safety mode for Numbers operations: safe_readonly, safe_manage, or full_access.

environmentVariables.name: APPLE_NUMBERS_MCP_ALLOWED_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated folders Numbers may open spreadsheets from and export to. Unset uses APPLE_FILES_MCP_ALLOWED_ROOTS, then the default folders.
